mods.abstract: New No. 4 D.D Home medical apparatus with standard dry cell battery, by J.H Bunnell & Company of 76 Cortland Street, New York. Apparatus includes 2 handles, 2 electrode disks, 2 cylinders, 2 electrode wires, electrode plate, dry cell battery, and printed directions.
